source_title: Months after release of GPT-6 Astra, report says two top Chinese AI companies ‘copied’ what OpenAI called - The Times of India

The technique, widely referred to across the industry as model distillation, has turned into a major flashpoint between global tech labs as competition between the US and China intensifies.American tech giants argue that systematically extracting and training on another company's synthetic responses allows competitors to replicate cutting-edge AI breakthroughs at a fraction of the time and capital expense.OpenAI details data harvesting claimsOpenAI had already sounded the alarm on unauthorised model scraping earlier this year.
